messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] high egress resolver latency detected in eu-west-1a — impact: increased inference tail latency and 502s on /v1/generate. Alert ID: INC-2026-4521
jon.sre: seeing spikes on the resolver path, GRPCTimeout / 502s from proxy pools, started collecting tcpdump on 10.4.23.11
maria-eng: confirmed 5-12% error rate for inference requests over the last 5m for eu-west-1a. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/latency/eu-west-1a (short link)
ashley-oncall: I'm taking pager. switching traffic -> eu-west-1b canary route now. Will lower DNS TTL for route53 records to 30s.
kevin-nwk: copying network team. prelim netlogs show resolver queries queuing at the AZ egress NAT. Possibly resolver headroom exhaustion after an upstream resolver backoff.
jon.sre: starting a soft-drain of ephemeral inference nodes in eu-west-1a to reduce connection churn: 
```
# cordon and drain ephemeral pool
rpk node set-drain --pool=eu-west-1a-ephemeral --reason="egress-resolver-latency"
```
ben-custsuccess: any customers currently hitting errors? we have a support thread flagged for a top-10 customer in EU.
olivia-pm: we saw elevated error reports from two customers (payments-ux, docs-search). flagged to CS. Maria, ETA on mitigation?
maria-eng: traffic reroute to eu-west-1b in progress (10% -> 60%). lowering batch size for eu-west-1a inference workers to avoid requeues. Patching routing policy to prefer b when latency > 200ms.
ashley-oncall: lowered route53 TTL to 30s (propagation in flight). also bumped per-instance connection limit on proxies in eu-west-1a as temporary relief: 
```
# temporary proxy config bump
config apply proxy/ew1a --max-conns=20000 --session-timeout=30s
```
kevin-nwk: in parallel we're asking upstream resolver to increase query QPS or move to alternate resolver pool. filing ticket with provider (case 987654).
infra-bot: autoscaler triggered +20 instances in eu-west-1b (dedicated pools) as of 3332134690 — capacity added to absorb reroute.
jon.sre: error rate dropped to ~1.7% post-reroute; tail latency improved from 820ms -> 210ms for streaming endpoints. tracking.
ben-custsuccess: notified affected customers with interim mitigation note. customers want ETA for full recovery.
olivia-pm: next steps: 1) confirm upstream resolver fix, 2) reintroduce drained nodes after healthy checks, 3) follow-up incident summary and comms. Assign owners?
maria-eng: I own 2 and 3 (reintroduce + postmortem). Kevin owns 1. Ashley continue oncall handoff in 30m.
nashley-oncall: oncall handoff scheduled to @jon.sre in 30m. leaving notes in incident channel and runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/egress-resolver-fanout.md :thumbsup:
jon.sre: thanks — I'll monitor for 2 hours and start rollback to normal routing after resolver confirmation. please add any customer impact details to the incident doc.
incident-bot: [UPDATE] mitigation threshold met at 3332134715 — traffic rebalanced, major impact mitigated. Please run post-incident survey when stable.
jon.sre: closing active mitigation. last check: 0.9% error rate; will mark incident as mitigated and start timeline notes.
infra-bot: created follow-up ticket INC-2026-4521-PM for postmortem and customer comms.
ben-custsuccess: will send follow-up to customers summarizing root cause & mitigations once PM draft is ready.
jon.sre: thanks team — nice quick coordination. leaving brief timeline in the doc now.
